title: Managed Database: remittance allocation
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database remittance allocation applies to database payment. The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using a payment methods rail and the amount actually received in currency. Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank. Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use collection order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity. Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities. Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference. A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting. No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.

## Evidence: confirmed payment
The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, status, external reference, method. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference. 

## Account measurement
All posted financial events through the current handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding. No independently writable balance is stored.
